title: Life of Pi
author: Yann Martel
summary: After a shipwreck, a teenage boy from India is left adrift in the Pacific in a lifeboat with a hyena, a zebra, an orangutan and a Bengal tiger, and must find a way to live alongside the last of them.
readIf: you want a survival story that doubles as a story about faith and storytelling.
skipIf: you can't read about animals killing each other, or want a conventional ending.

pairings.reason: A shorter, quieter tale of one person pushed to the limit on the sea.
A simpler survival tale for younger readers with the same focus on resourcefulness.
Another novel where a young man's journey becomes a parable about belief.
